summary: The note is a short encyclopedic entry on Luiz Mott, a Brazilian researcher, anthropologist and historian born in São Paulo in 1946. It identifies him as one of Brazil's most notable gay civil rights activists. The note is brief and gives no further biographical detail.
one_line: Brazilian anthropologist, historian and researcher born in São Paulo in 1946, known as a leading gay civil rights activist in Brazil.
